name: Sach Pass and Pangi valley
one_line: Himachal Pradesh into Jammu and Kashmir, from Chamba over Sach Pass to Killar in Pangi, then down the Chenab to Kishtwar

fuel.note: Pumps are those drawn on the open map within the search radius of the road. A pump missing from the map is missing here, so each gap is a worst case.

rules.title: Sach Pass: no permit; identity checked at Satrundi
rules.detail: A rider blog reports no permit for Indian citizens. Police at Satrundi check identity and the rider signs an undertaking. No written order was found.

rules.title: Sach Pass: closed each winter by district order
rules.detail: The Deputy Commissioner of Chamba shuts the road under the Motor Vehicles Act once ice sets in. Newspapers give 15 October as the usual closing date.

history.change: Closure ordered under Section 115 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988, until further notice.

rules.title: Sach Pass opens to light vehicles first
rules.detail: After snow clearance only light motor vehicles may cross. Heavy vehicles and buses wait for a fitness certificate. Reports do not mention motorcycles.
rules.set_by: Himachal Pradesh Public Works Department and Chamba district administration

rules.title: Killar to Kishtwar: no permit; check posts on the way
rules.detail: A rider blog reports no permit for Indian citizens, a check post at the Sansari bridge state boundary, and registration at Gulabgarh during the Machail pilgrimage. No order found.

history.change: Registration at Gulabgarh reported for the pilgrimage period, 25 July to 8 September 2026.

rules.title: Himachal entry toll for vehicles from other states
rules.detail: Charged at entry barriers under the yearly toll policy. Notified rates name passenger and goods vehicles only. The Chief Minister said two-wheelers stay exempt. The policy document was not opened.
rules.set_by: Department of State Taxes and Excise, Government of Himachal Pradesh

hazards.title: Snow walls and falling stones after opening
hazards.detail: Snow walls line several stretches in the first weeks, with stones coming down and a slippery surface from melt.

source.title: After seven-month freeze, Pangi valley's lifeline Sach Pass opens to traffic

hazards.title: Water crossings on the Sach Pass road
hazards.detail: Melt streams run across the road and are deepest in the afternoon.

hazards.title: No fuel between Chamba and Killar
hazards.detail: A rider blog reports the last petrol pump is in Chamba, with none on the way over the pass.

hazards.title: No mobile network beyond Bairagarh
hazards.detail: Signal is reported to drop out after Bairagarh, so help cannot be called from the pass.

hazards.title: Early snow in October
hazards.detail: Snow blocked the Satrundi to Sach Pass road on 6 October 2025, cutting Pangi off.

source.title: White October: Pangi wakes up to snow, Chamba shivers under rain

hazards.title: Cliff road from Killar to Kishtwar
hazards.detail: Single-lane and largely unpaved, with blind turns, loose gravel, overhanging rock and long drops. Landslides and mud in the monsoon.

hazards.title: No fuel between Killar and Gulabgarh
hazards.detail: A rider blog reports no pump on this stretch and unreliable stock at the one pump in Killar.

hazards.title: Winter snow on the Killar to Kishtwar road
hazards.detail: Heavy snow shut the road in January 2026; it was restored on 1 February 2026.

gaps: No highway number found for the Chamba to Tissa to Killar road or for the Killar to Kishtwar road.
Closing dates for 2022, 2023 and 2025 were not found. Newspapers give 15 October as the official yearly closing date, but the 2024 order came on 3 December.
The 2026 opening date is unclear: two reports from the same newspaper give late April and the second week of May.
No report says when motorcycles, as distinct from light motor vehicles, are allowed over the pass.
The identity check and undertaking at Satrundi are reported by a rider blog only.

Himachal entry toll: the two-wheeler exemption rests on a newspaper report of the Chief Minister's statement (26 March 2026). The official Toll Policy 2026-27 document on hptax.gov.in failed to open (certificate error), so it is not confirmed for motorcycles registered in other states.

Jammu and Kashmir side (Killar to Gulabgarh to Kishtwar): rules, check posts and road status come from one rider blog; no official page or order was found, and no office that announces status was identified.
Videos: titles and channels were read from the video pages; filming dates are not confirmed.
Not on the line: Bairagarh, between Tissa and Sach Pass: no position found on the open map
